verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents automation that runs in the background without user action: recurring subscription charges, Smart Retries for failed payments, and customer communications driven by 'Stripe Billing automations'. These are built-in, predefined behaviors run on a recurring basis, but the evidence for user-defined automations is a single mention, with no detail on triggers, conditions or actions. Missing for 10: documented configurable automation workflows (trigger/condition/action builder), depth on the Billing automations feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: It automates recurring payments, creates custom pricing plans, and handles billing periods, such as trials and renewals.
Stripe Billing can automatically retry failed subscription and invoice payments for you.
Automate many of your customer interactions by combining a customer portal with customer communications controlled by Stripe Billing automations.
Allows you to charge the customer on a recurring basis
